item.title: Qatar's Ministry of Foreign Affairs strongly condemned continued Iranian attacks on the Kingdom of Bahrain, calling them a violation of its…
item.description:
Qatar's Ministry of Foreign Affairs strongly condemned continued Iranian attacks on the Kingdom of Bahrain, calling them a violation of its sovereignty and territorial integrity, of international law and of the UN Charter, warned that they undermine regional security and ongoing diplomatic efforts, urged all parties to prioritise dialogue, and affirmed Qatar's full solidarity with Bahrain and support for all measures it takes to protect its security.
Sources: News of Bahrain https://www.newsofbahrain.com/en/article/qatar-condemns-continued-iranian-attacks-on-bahrain · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/17/11/2026/qatar-strongly-condemns-continued-iranian-attacks-on-bahrain

item.title: Qatar's stance came hours after Foreign Ministry spokesperson Dr Majed bin Mohammed Al Ansari announced a meeting with Iranian officials as…
item.description:
Qatar's stance came hours after Foreign Ministry spokesperson Dr Majed bin Mohammed Al Ansari announced a meeting with Iranian officials as part of mediation efforts and warned that further escalation could undermine efforts to end the war. As of Tuesday evening, no breakthrough had been announced.
Sources: Euronews https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/17/qatar-warns-gulf-escalation-poses-grave-danger-and-announces-new-talks-with-iran · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/17/11/2026/qatar-iran-to-hold-meeting-today-as-mediation-efforts-continue · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/uae/middle-east-war-8-things-uae-residents-need-to-know-tonight-november-17-1.500750894

item.title: The Ministry of Communications and Information Technology, the Ministry of Education and Higher Education and Qatar University, in technica…
item.description:
The Ministry of Communications and Information Technology, the Ministry of Education and Higher Education and Qatar University, in technical partnership with Scale AI, launched two national AI projects at the Four Seasons Hotel Doha: a "Smart Assistant" for students in grades four to 12 across six subjects, and an "Academic Adviser Assistant" for Qatar University students linked to the student information system, with teaching decisions kept with qualified staff. The launch coincided with Qatar hosting the 2026 ITU Plenipotentiary Conference.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/17/11/2026/qatar-launches-two-national-ai-projects-to-enhance-school-learning-university-academic-advising · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/264829/latest-news/qatar-launches-two-national-ai-projects-to-enhance-school-learning-university-academic-advising

item.title: The QE Index closed Tuesday at 10,079.41, down 27.59 points (0.27%), after trimming morning losses of 0.86%. Investors traded 116.04 millio…
item.description:
The QE Index closed Tuesday at 10,079.41, down 27.59 points (0.27%), after trimming morning losses of 0.86%. Investors traded 116.04 million shares worth QR305.99 million in 21,240 transactions; market capitalisation fell to QR616.97 billion from QR619.11 billion. Qatar National Bank slipped 0.6%, with 13 gainers, 36 losers and 4 unchanged.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/17/11/2026/qatar-stock-market-closes-lower-as-index-falls-027 · Business Recorder (Reuters) https://www.brecorder.com/news/40449367/gulf-bourses-close-mixed-as-shipping-security-concerns-linger

item.title: The national team lost a friendly 1-0 to South Korea at Abdullah bin Khalifa Stadium; Oh Se-hun headed the winner just before half-time fro…
item.description:
The national team lost a friendly 1-0 to South Korea at Abdullah bin Khalifa Stadium; Oh Se-hun headed the winner just before half-time from a Song Min-kyu cross. The visitors dominated with 65% possession and 13 shots in the first half, while goalkeeper Zakaria made several saves.
Sources: VAVEL https://www.vavel.com/en-us/soccer/2026/11/17/1279523-qatar-vs-south-korea-live-latest-score-goals-and-friendly-updates.html · SBS News https://news.sbs.co.kr/english/article.do?news_id=N1008850681

item.title: Bahraini air defences intercepted Iranian air attacks on Tuesday in the third round within days, preceded by alerts telling residents to mo…
item.description:
Bahraini air defences intercepted Iranian air attacks on Tuesday in the third round within days, preceded by alerts telling residents to move to the nearest safe place. The IRGC said six drones targeted a US air-defence radar, while US Central Command denied any damage or injuries after the drones were intercepted. Bahrain invoked Article 51 of the UN Charter and called on the Security Council to act.
Sources: Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/uae/middle-east-war-8-things-uae-residents-need-to-know-tonight-november-17-1.500750894 · Asharq Al-Awsat https://english.aawsat.com/node/5341319

item.title: Gulf condemnations followed: Kuwait strongly condemned continued Iranian attacks on Bahrain as a breach of international law, the UN Charte…
item.description:
Gulf condemnations followed: Kuwait strongly condemned continued Iranian attacks on Bahrain as a breach of international law, the UN Charter and Security Council Resolution 2817 (2026), and the UAE condemned the attack as a violation of the kingdom's sovereignty, following condemnations from Qatar and Saudi Arabia.
Sources: News of Bahrain https://www.newsofbahrain.com/en/article/kuwait-condemns-iranian-attacks-on-bahrain · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/uae/middle-east-war-8-things-uae-residents-need-to-know-tonight-november-17-1.500750894 · Arab News https://www.arabnews.com/saudi-arabia/saudi-arabia-condemns-repeated-iranian-attacks-on-bahrain-3012505

item.title: The Panama-flagged LPG tanker Tara Gas was hit a second time off Oman, forcing its crew to abandon ship, after a first attack on Monday abo…
item.description:
The Panama-flagged LPG tanker Tara Gas was hit a second time off Oman, forcing its crew to abandon ship, after a first attack on Monday about seven nautical miles north of Khasab. India's shipping minister said 24 of the 25 crew are accounted for and the search for a missing Indian sailor continues. UKMTO also confirmed that another tanker was struck by a projectile in the Gulf on 13 November, with no injuries.
Sources: Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/uae/middle-east-war-8-things-uae-residents-need-to-know-tonight-november-17-1.500750894 · The Maritime Executive https://maritime-executive.com/article/lpg-tanker-abandoned-off-oman-after-two-strikes-and-in-danger-of-exploding

item.title: Foreign Minister Sayyid Badr bin Hamad Albusaidi described his meeting in Muscat with Iranian counterpart Abbas Araghchi as "constructive";…
item.description:
Foreign Minister Sayyid Badr bin Hamad Albusaidi described his meeting in Muscat with Iranian counterpart Abbas Araghchi as "constructive"; it focused on safeguarding maritime corridors and navigation security, with no breakthrough announced.
Sources: Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/uae/middle-east-war-8-things-uae-residents-need-to-know-tonight-november-17-1.500750894 · Oman Observer https://www.omanobserver.om/article/1199812/oman/oman-iran-stress-maritime-security-amid-regional-tensions

item.title: UAE President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan received a written message from Russian President Vladimir Putin delivered by Russian Secu…
item.description:
UAE President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan received a written message from Russian President Vladimir Putin delivered by Russian Security Council Secretary Sergei Shoigu, expressing Moscow's appreciation for the UAE hosting the US-Russia-Ukraine trilateral talks and for its mediation, which continues to secure prisoner exchanges. He also received the team that organised the UAE Annual Government Meetings and praised its success.
Sources: Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/uae/government/uae-president-receives-written-message-from-putin-delivered-by-russian-security-council-secretary-1.500749768 · Sharjah24 https://sharjah24.ae/en/Articles/2026/11/17/AL021 · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/uae/government/uae-president-praises-annual-government-meetings-team-1.500751123

item.title: Saudi Arabia lost a friendly 2-1 to Uzbekistan at Jassim bin Hamad Stadium in Doha: Sherzod Esanov scored in the 19th and 35th minutes, Fir…
item.description:
Saudi Arabia lost a friendly 2-1 to Uzbekistan at Jassim bin Hamad Stadium in Doha: Sherzod Esanov scored in the 19th and 35th minutes, Firas Al-Buraikan replied for Saudi Arabia around the 23rd, and Ali Lajami was sent off six minutes after coming on at half-time. The defeat ended a seven-match unbeaten run (five wins, two draws), and coach Georgios Donis's future is in doubt.
Sources: Arab News https://www.arabnews.com/football/green-falcons-undone-by-early-errors-and-a-red-card-in-2-1-loss-to-uzbekistan-3012532 · Goal https://www.goal.com/en/news/after-seven-matches-uzbekistan-end-saudi-arabia-s-run-and-inflict-donis-s-third-defeat/blt1ebf077eba7032ea

item.title: The national team drew 0-0 with Malawi at Bingu National Stadium in the fourth round of 2027 Africa Cup of Nations qualifying, after winnin…
item.description:
The national team drew 0-0 with Malawi at Bingu National Stadium in the fourth round of 2027 Africa Cup of Nations qualifying, after winning the first leg 5-0. Egypt are second in Group B on 8 points behind Angola (10), who beat South Sudan 1-0, followed by Malawi (4) and South Sudan (0). Coach Ali Maher blamed the poor pitch.
Sources: AfricaSoccer https://africasoccer.com/afcon-2027-qualifiers-malawi-hold-egypt/ · PanAfrica Football https://panafricafootball.com/article/egypt-malawi-afcon-angola-south-sudan-11-26 · Elbalad News https://elbalad.news/7183117

item.title: Prime Minister Dr Mostafa Madbouly inaugurated the second phase of the Haier Egypt industrial complex in 10th of Ramadan City and its VRF c…
item.description:
Prime Minister Dr Mostafa Madbouly inaugurated the second phase of the Haier Egypt industrial complex in 10th of Ramadan City and its VRF central air-conditioning line. The complex now produces TVs, washing machines, household and central air conditioners, refrigerators and industrial components, provides about 3,000 jobs, and the company aims to triple output in five years and lift business volume to $500 million; local VRF production is expected to save hundreds of millions of dollars in imports a year.
Sources: The Egyptian Gazette https://egyptian-gazette.com/egypt/pm-inaugurates-2nd-phase-of-haier-egypt-industrial-complex · Elbalad News https://elbalad.news/7183117

The dollar ended Tuesday in a narrow range: EGP 53.63 buy and 53.73 sell at the National Bank of Egypt and Banque Misr per the evening reading, and EGP 53.61 to 53.75 at the Central Bank, while other closing readings showed 53.67 buy and 53.77 sell.

item.description:
The Egyptian Exchange ended Tuesday broadly lower: EGX30 fell 0.99% to 51,681.62, the small and mid-cap EGX70 2.42% to 17,592.75 and EGX100 2.03% to 23,535.06, on turnover of about EGP 9 billion. Market capitalisation lost about EGP 56.9 billion to close at EGP 4.09 trillion; Egyptians were net sellers of about EGP 222.1 million while Arabs (EGP 107.8 million) and foreigners (EGP 114.3 million) were net buyers, and Talaat Moustafa Group fell 1.8%.

Gold 21-carat fell to EGP 5,905 a gram on Tuesday afternoon, with 24-carat at about EGP 6,749, 18-carat at about EGP 5,061 and the gold pound at EGP 47,240, as the ounce hovered near $3,860 globally.

item.title: Opening a World Intellectual Property Organization copyright conference in the New Capital, the Prime Minister called for a more influentia…
item.description:
Opening a World Intellectual Property Organization copyright conference in the New Capital, the Prime Minister called for a more influential voice for developing countries in shaping AI and intellectual-property rules. In energy, the government is considering electricity-saving incentives while expanding solar power projects.
Sources: Daily News Egypt https://dailynewsegypt.com/2026/11/16/madbouly-opens-wipo-copyright-conference-in-new-capital-as-ai-tests-protection-for-creators/ · Elbalad News https://elbalad.news/7183117 · Daily News Egypt https://dailynewsegypt.com/2026/11/16/egypt-considers-electricity-saving-incentives-expands-solar-power-projects/

item.title: A Ukrainian drone and missile strike brought down a metal arch and the road span beneath it on the Kerch Bridge; Ukraine's SBU said the ope…
item.description:
A Ukrainian drone and missile strike brought down a metal arch and the road span beneath it on the Kerch Bridge; Ukraine's SBU said the operation took about a month in seven stages, while rail traffic resumed on one track. At least two people were killed in Crimea, according to its Moscow-installed governor; Russia said it downed 1,441 drones overnight and struck two bridges in Kyiv, damaging the metro and partly cutting water and power. It comes two days before Putin, Trump and Xi meet in Shenzhen on Thursday 19 November.
Sources: Al Jazeera https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/17/ukrainian-drone-attack-kills-two-in-crimea-as-kyiv-targets-kerch-bridge · Military.com (Reuters) https://www.military.com/ukraine-strikes-section-of-russias-crimean-bridge-two-days-before-putin-meets-trump-xi

item.title: President Trump said in Manila that Washington takes "very seriously" reports of possible Iranian plans to use a "dirty bomb", warning that…
item.description:
President Trump said in Manila that Washington takes "very seriously" reports of possible Iranian plans to use a "dirty bomb", warning that Iran "will pay a price the likes of which no country has ever paid before" if it did so. Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baghaei called the report baseless, while the White House said there are no credible threats to the homeland. The USS Theodore Roosevelt has joined two other carriers in the region as the naval blockade of Iranian ports continues.
Sources: Yahoo News https://www.yahoo.com/news/politics/articles/trump-dirty-bomb-report-very-121918225.html · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/uae/middle-east-war-8-things-uae-residents-need-to-know-tonight-november-17-1.500750894

item.title: Wall Street losses widened on Tuesday, led by tech, ahead of Nvidia's results: the Dow fell 1.58% to 50,794.40, the S&P 500 1.21% to 7,326.…
item.description:
Wall Street losses widened on Tuesday, led by tech, ahead of Nvidia's results: the Dow fell 1.58% to 50,794.40, the S&P 500 1.21% to 7,326.60 and the Nasdaq 1.13% to 24,231.20 during the session, according to Reuters. Salesforce fell 8.5% and Intel 3% after Nvidia cut its stake by 25%, and Nvidia shares slipped about 1.7% before results due after the close, with analysts expecting revenue of $109.11 billion.
Sources: MarketScreener (Reuters) https://www.marketscreener.com/news/wall-street-falters-ahead-of-nvidia-earnings-anthropic-debut-ce785edcdc88f725 · Yahoo Finance https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-tuesday-november-17-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-nvidia-earnings-retail-sales-143848454.html · GV Wire (Reuters) https://gvwire.com/2026/11/17/wall-street-slips-ahead-of-nvidia-results-anthropic-ipo/

item.title: US retail sales rose 0.2% in October against expectations of 0.1%, with September revised to 0.8%, and rose 0.5% excluding autos and gas. T…
item.description:
US retail sales rose 0.2% in October against expectations of 0.1%, with September revised to 0.8%, and rose 0.5% excluding autos and gas. The homebuilder sentiment index fell 4 points to 25 in November, its lowest since April 2012. St. Louis Fed President Musalem called for rate hikes "sooner", totalling 100 to 150 basis points, and the probability of a 25-basis-point December hike rose to 95.4% according to FedWatch.
Sources: Yahoo Finance https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-tuesday-november-17-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-nvidia-earnings-retail-sales-143848454.html · MarketScreener (Reuters) https://www.marketscreener.com/news/wall-street-falters-ahead-of-nvidia-earnings-anthropic-debut-ce785edcdc88f725

item.title: European shares had their worst day in eight months: the STOXX 600 closed down 1.75% at 650.72, the Euro Stoxx 50 fell 2.15% and the DAX mo…
item.description:
European shares had their worst day in eight months: the STOXX 600 closed down 1.75% at 650.72, the Euro Stoxx 50 fell 2.15% and the DAX more than 2%, while tech dropped 3.9%, its steepest daily fall since 3 February, and ASML lost 5.3%. Deutsche Bank fell about 6% after reports based on leaked documents about its dealings with clients including Russian oligarchs.
Sources: MarketScreener (Reuters) https://www.marketscreener.com/news/european-stocks-mark-worst-day-in-eight-months-on-ai-jitters-deutsche-bank-slides-ce785edcdd8df723 · JournalArta https://journalarta.com/en/2026/11/17/european-shares-fall-deutsche-bank-tech-stocks-nvidia/

item.title: Oil steadied on Tuesday after Monday's sharp drop: Brent traded around $92.61 to $92.98 a barrel and US crude above $86, as the expected su…
item.description:
Oil steadied on Tuesday after Monday's sharp drop: Brent traded around $92.61 to $92.98 a barrel and US crude above $86, as the expected supply surplus (the IEA sees about 1.7 million barrels a day of excess in the fourth quarter) weighed against tanker-attack risks near Hormuz. OPEC+ meets on 29 November to discuss 2027 output policy.
Sources: EnergyNow https://energynow.ca/2026/11/oil-prices-stabilize-after-mondays-sharp-selloff-as-global-supply-surplus-offsets-middle-east-tanker-risks/ · Arbiterz https://arbiterz.com/oil-prices-today-oil-prices-rise-as-brent-reclaims-92-wti-trades-above-86

item.title: All eyes are on Anthropic's IPO, which Reuters says targets a valuation of up to $1.4 trillion, with trading expected to begin on Thursday,…
item.description:
All eyes are on Anthropic's IPO, which Reuters says targets a valuation of up to $1.4 trillion, with trading expected to begin on Thursday, as the Philadelphia semiconductor index's year-to-date gain has shrunk to about 34% from as much as 106% in June.
